children: Private Equity-Venture Capital (PE-VC) investments surged to over $8 billion across 106 deals in October led by the $5.6 billion equity investment in IDBI Bank by Canada’s Fairfax Financial Holdings.

The mega deal helped October 2026 record the highest monthly investment level in over four years surpassing last month’s high of $6.1 billion across 125 deals, as per data from market research firm Venture Intelligence.
On a year-on-year (y-o-y) basis, investments went up nearly 50 per cent from $5.5 billion across 136 deals in October 2025.

title: IDBI-Fairfax mega deal takes PE-VC investments to $8 billion in October
